description: Use when cracking password hashes or auditing password strength on an authorized engagement. Covers hash identification, hashcat 6.2.6 and John the Ripper 1.9.0-jumbo-1 workflows, wordlist strategy, rule-based mutation, mask and hybrid attacks, and interpreting results for the report. Use when you recovered hashes from a database dump, a SAM file, /etc/shadow, or an application backup, or when the client asked for a password audit.
